title: Rav Ada son of Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Chullin 57b according to Ein Yaakov, raising an objection to Rav Ashi; Hyman says the reading should be Rav Acha son of Rava.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Chullin 57b paragraph explicitly has Rav Acha son of Rava raising the objection to Rav Ashi. Hyman’s fully written Rav Ada heading and his Ein Yaakov reading remain distinct; his ‘should read’ retains its force. Ein Yaakov itself was not freshly collated, and the two names are not merged.
